purpose: Standardize God Mode architecture decisions and development workflow through ADR, evidence, validation, rollback, and governance handoff.

workflow.rule: Define which SEIS modules, layers, and user outcomes are affected before editing.
workflow.evidence: Work package section and module coverage contract.

workflow.rule: Record architectural decisions when the change affects governance, platform boundaries, agent behavior, security, release readiness, or long-term maintainability.
workflow.evidence: ADR file using the SEIS ADR template.

workflow.rule: Implement bounded, reversible slices with source-controlled contracts, docs, scripts, and UI when user-visible.
workflow.evidence: Primary files listed in the work package.

workflow.rule: Run or request the relevant validation plan commands before completion, commit, push, or release claims.
workflow.evidence: Validation plan command group and command output.

workflow.rule: Report changes, validation status, risks, rollback, and next steps without hiding unverified work.
workflow.evidence: Final response, commit message, PR body, or release note.

completionRule: A God Mode architectural change is incomplete unless its decision path is either captured in an ADR or explicitly identified as not requiring one.
